name: universal-lint
description: Silently runs each language's standard linter (read-only — never autofixes) on Shell, Java, Kotlin, JS/TS, Python, Go, YAML, Markdown, CSS, SCSS, PHP and Rust files, surfacing any findings as additional context for Claude to fix (shellcheck, checkstyle, ktlint, eslint, ruff check, golangci-lint/go vet, yamllint, markdownlint-cli2/markdownlint, stylelint, phpstan/psalm, cargo clippy/cargo check; eslint/oxlint/markdownlint-cli2/markdownlint/stylelint also fall back to npx; runs through rtk for more compact output when rtk is present); yamllint/markdownlint's max-line-length rule is skipped when the project has no linter config of its own; JSON is intentionally not covered (no exit-code-clean standalone JSON linter exists); no-op when the linter is absent. Always active once installed — no on/off toggle. Each Write/Edit lints the written file immediately in the background; files changed outside Write/Edit inside the session's working directory (a formatter run from Bash, git operations, an external editor) are linted via FileChanged, skipping git-ignored and unchanged files.
